digest.component_or_area: plan-review coaching moves and criterion routing
propositions: A coaching move must detect and redirect agents when plan scope inventories (affected files and call sites) were enumerated by hand or are demonstrably incomplete, rather than derived from the symbol graph.
The criterion must route to plan_review only (not code_review), because code_review's applies_when vocabulary is a closed set excluding project.* ids, making such a move permanently dead.
Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven via code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring changes are required.

The criterion fires reliably on hand-enumerated inventories at agent tier, naming omitted files including string-literal sites (monkeypatch.setattr) that symbol tools cannot resolve, but does not guarantee move selection due to coach LLM preferences.

The criterion must be advisory (default_posture: advisory) with no inert blocking_enabled key, and the move's template must direct re-derivation with both find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweeps.
All overlay assets must be project-only with no changes to src/rebar/ shipped defaults, and the criterion id must not appear under src/rebar/.
